title: precheck warns of a content item that rewords a DOC fact and lacks its root's _anchors.csv
goal: precheck warns of a committed item whose touches name an article of a kb root and lack that root's _anchors.csv (a touch that covers it counts) when its goal words a DOC fact reworded or added (the words DOC, reword or reworded), naming the root and the file to add

gates.question: How does precheck decide that an item rewords or adds a DOC fact, so its touches need the root's _anchors.csv: its goal says so (the words DOC, reword or reworded), or any touch of a kb root's article (a research story and every content item then warns)?
